parsed.summary: The drawing is internally consistent and matches the specification (correct buck/feedback values giving ~5 V, 3.3 V LDO, INA219 on a 10 mΩ shunt, dual MCU parts, crystals, and the documented 'RESET AND INTERRUPT PINS ARE MIXED UP' barometer bug). The one value that differs from the spec table — the PCA9685 being strapped to I2C address 0x41 (A0 tied high) instead of the spec's stated 0x40 — is required because the INA219 already occupies 0x40 on the same I2C2 bus, so the schematic reflects the only feasible intended design (a spec transcription error), not a deviation; no other drawing-supported anomaly was found.
